Typography,
image,

Graphic designer based in Italy, about to graduate from the Academy of Fine Arts of Macerata. I work on visual identity, editorial design and digital communication, exploring the relationship between typography, image and space.

Visual identity / Editorial design / Digital communication

Type design / Thesis project01

TileBound

A modular pixel art font developed for my graduation thesis. Each glyph represents a map element: trees, roads, water, structures, objects and characters.

Inspired by video games, I designed a system of repeatable, combinable elements built on a shared grid. The result is a tool for creating different maps through typography.

Grid: 40 × 40 pixels
Built with: Glyphs
Variants: OpenType
203 glyphs in total
Graduation project / 2026

Try it: build your own map

Pick a glyph (or press a letter key; [ ] cycle through variants). Click and drag on the grid; Shift or right-click erases. The glyphs are the real ones from the Glyphs file.

Editorial design / Typography02

Love Letters

For Love Letters, I chose to turn the letter E into a story. I imagined it as a kind of DNA, the letter’s own DNA. Through the repetition and composition of its forms, the E becomes a genuine genetic code.

Editorial design / Photography03

Compasso d’oro

For this project I chose the die, because I found its design and history particularly interesting. I explored the object through photography, creating a photo book focused on its form and details.

Poster design / Experimentation04

Workshop

A visual reinterpretation of Church symbols in a contemporary key. I chose the San Damiano Cross of Saint Francis, turning its traditional form into a modern graphic language.

Image making / Photoshop05

Human / Nature

A series of Photoshop experiments exploring the relationship between humans and nature. I turned human figures into hybrid forms with trees, creating surreal images in which the two elements merge into a single form.

Visual identity / OffTopic Group06

Brand Identity

I worked with OffTopic Group on the development of its visual identity. I designed the logos for OffTopic Group, OffGrowth and OffEvents.
